title: Step-Down Addition for Members in Care Management: Prior Authorization Transition Units
content:
**Rule.** The step-down addition of a transition-of-care request looks at the member's active care management episode and at the care plan updates recorded in the month before the day the request is recorded: where the active episode is Complex Case Management or Health Home Services and at least one such care plan update is recorded, three units are added; where the active episode is of any other tier and at least one such update is recorded, one unit is added; otherwise nothing is added.

The addition is made once to the units a Prior Authorization transition-of-care request asks for, before the ceiling of the class's most units per approval is applied. Both parts of the condition are read from the member's Care Management records: the tier of the episode whose status is active, and the care plan update entries dated in the month before the request day.

## Truth table

| Active Care Management episode | Care plan update in the month before | Units added |
|---|---|---|
| Complex Case Management | at least 1 | 3 |
| Health Home Services | at least 1 | 3 |
| any other tier (Healthy Living Support, Care Coordination Level 1, Care Coordination Level 2, Maternal Care Management, LTSS Service Coordination) | at least 1 | 1 |
| any tier | none | 0 |
| no active episode | any | 0 |

## Points of judgement

- An episode that is not active does not count, whatever its tier.
- The number of care plan updates beyond the first does not change the addition.
- *Hypothetical:* a member in an active Care Coordination Level 2 episode with two care plan updates in the month before the request day receives an addition of 1 unit; the same member with no update in that month receives none.
